prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: Frontier Airlines had the highest percentage of delayed flights in 2024—about **28.4%** of its flights, corresponding to an on-time rate of roughly **71.6%**, according to the U.S. DOT’s Air Travel Consumer Report.
